summary: Functional Brands Inc. entered into an Asset Purchase Agreement to acquire certain assets and intellectual property, including the Alchemy blockchain product, from BullionFX. Consideration is 100,000 shares of newly created Series D Convertible Preferred Stock with an expected value of $142.9 million, which automatically converts into common stock upon stockholder approval. The board recommends the transaction; no advisors named. Closing expected in Q2/Q3 2026, subject to conditions including consent of Series C preferred holders, litigation settlement, due diligence completion, a valuation report, D&O insurance tail, and a minimum $10 million equity financing. Close not contingent on shareholder approval; conversion approval sought post-close. Watch for stockholder vote and Nasdaq listing standards compliance, key risk-arb factors.
